headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas let a tilt alert lock you out with Binance's own cooling-off, show your results by hour of day and hours into the session, and flag choppy movers where EMA alignment is mostly noise.

ideas.title: Tilt alert offers Binance's cooling-off lock
ideas.why: Binance Futures has a cooling-off period (1 day up to a month) that can't be lifted once set. When the bot sees a revenge pattern or a 5 USDT give-back, it should tell you to switch it on now. A lock you can't undo works when willpower doesn't, like on 25 Oct.

ideas.title: Results by hour of day and hours into the session
ideas.why: In a trading experiment, people trading at their less alert times took riskier positions and earned about a third less. Split your PnL and rule breaks by Addis hour and by hours since your first trade, so the brief can say when you should already be done for the day.

ideas.title: "Choppy" flag from the 15m Choppiness Index
ideas.why: EMA 9/21 alignment often flips back and forth in sideways chop, which is where scalps bleed. The Choppiness Index (14 bars) runs on the 15m candles the scanner already has: over 61.8 means sideways. Flag those coins and keep them out of Clean picks, with no extra API calls.

watch: Binance cuts max leverage on 15 USDⓈ-M contracts today from 06:30 UTC (09:30 Addis): APR, AIO, TRIA, WET and STBL go from 50x to 25x, and 10 others (incl. GOAT, TURTLE, TRADOOR) lose their top tier. Open positions are affected.
